scope.selection: The sole intersection of the two existing predictions_best/index.json case lists; intersection determined from JSON, without looking at any prediction or GT array. Each model remains at its already u-only-validation-selected checkpoint.

euclidean.index_policy: at most4 train/validation representatives; no dia/test

graph.index_policy: at most4 train/validation representatives; no dia/test

scope.selection_limit: The exporter chooses at most4 train/validation representatives. Its selection is not random or a complete group. The shared exported TRAIN hard case is a bounded descriptive diagnostic, not evidence about all TRAIN cases, all validation cases, causal mechanisms, or generalization. This replaces the earlier historical-four-case suggestion.

expected_fields.u_scale_mm: scalar; true/pred are already physically decoded, do not decode again

prediction_schema_source_evidence.implementation_first_check: Verify both exports have the same all-node xyz and u_true_mm, expected key/step/channels/N, finite fields and XYZ hash against the existing cache. If inconsistent or absent, fail; do not create replacement fields.

normalization.source: only existing canonical prepared geometry metadata; no H5/raw geometry scan

APIs: recover_node_tensor_strain(cell_strain,volumes,cells,node_count,batch_size=262144): FP64 incident-volume average to ALL10 original node IDs
node_tensor_metrics(reference,prediction): unweighted all-node symmetric Frobenius relativeL2 with truth/error energy
cache_and_operator.physical_xyz: xyz_mm=xyz*characteristic_length_mm+bbox_min_mm using manifest normalization; no rawH5 or original prepared GT is needed. Cached inverse edges already use physical mm.

bounded_design_draft.one_descriptive_question: On this same exported TRAIN case, does the recovered P1 residual remain large after oracle affine displacement-error removal, and how is that residual associated with input-only corner-edge length?
bounded_design_draft.affine_oracle: For each model, fit e=u_pred-u_true in FP64 unweighted all-node least squares to physical affine coordinates X=[1,xyz_mm-centered_mean], with coordinate columns scaled by the common characteristic_length_mm for conditioning. This is equivalent to subtracting affine projections of true and predicted displacement. Define e_aff=P(e),e_res=e-e_aff. Report the true displacement affine/non-affine descriptors too. The GT-based fit is an oracle description, not deployable correction, boundary enforcement, or model selection.
bounded_design_draft.same_reference: A=unchanged physical corner P1 plus full-cell incident-volume recovery. S_ref is the existing cached float32 tor reference, cast FP64 and recovered using the same full mesh. Retain S_ref in all comparisons.
bounded_design_draft.tensor_partition: s_total=A(u_pred)-S_ref; s_aff=A(e_aff); s_res=A(u_pred-e_aff)-S_ref; then s_total=s_aff+s_res. Record A(u_true)-S_ref once as cache-reference rounding discrepancy; never silently replace the immutable reference.
bounded_design_draft.cross_terms: For u and recovered tensor strain, compute actual E_total, E_aff, E_res and signed 2<aff,res>, plus closure error. Tensor inner product weights are [1,1,1,2,2,2]. Do not assume strain orthogonality, force positive shares to sum to100%, or clip cancellation/reinforcement.

physical_RMS_and_denominators.u: Use original full-case truth energy sum ||u_true||^2 mm^2. Component RMSE=sqrt(error_energy/(3N)) mm; vector RMS=sqrt(error_energy/N) mm; relativeL2=sqrt(error_energy/truth_energy). Name the two RMS conventions separately.
physical_RMS_and_denominators.strain: Use original full-case recovered S_ref Frobenius truth energy. RMS=sqrt(error_energy/N), dimensionless, no divide by6; relativeL2=sqrt(error_energy/truth_energy).
physical_RMS_and_denominators.fixed_denominator: All affine/residual/bin relative energy contributions use this same original complete-case truth denominator, with denominator values printed. No renormalization by the remaining affine-removed truth or bin truth.
physical_RMS_and_denominators.cell_measure: Full-volume-weighted cell tensor RMS/loss is a separate diagnostic, never called all-node recovered P1 relativeL2.

single_input_only_bin_protocol.length: h_mm=min of six physical TETRA corner-edge lengths, h=h_mm/characteristic_length_mm. Recover three physical edge rows by inverting the cached inverse edge matrix; derive the other three pair edges. No other length definition or cutoff sweep.
single_input_only_bin_protocol.partition: Four fixed geometry quartile bins from this one CAD h array only, computed once and shared by both models. They use no prediction or GT. Collapse and explicitly report duplicate quartile boundaries deterministically.
single_input_only_bin_protocol.cell_readout: Cell count and physical volume fraction; volume-weighted cell residual Frobenius RMS, with full-case cell truth denominator separately named.
single_input_only_bin_protocol.all_node_attribution: Zero residual cell tensors outside a bin and recover using ALL cells and ALL original positive volumes. Never restrict incident-volume denominators to a bin. The sum of bin-recovered fields equals the total recovered residual.
single_input_only_bin_protocol.node_cross_terms: Include diagonal bin energies plus all six signed pair cross terms for four bins. Disjoint cells share recovered nodes and are not orthogonal; verify numeric energy closure.

bounded_design_draft.minimum_next_implementation: One CPU-only tool loading exactly the two fixed prediction NPZ files and the one10_58 gradient cache; no new inference/optimizer/weights, no other case or cutoff. Write one bounded machine-readable readout with descriptive units, source/selection identities and limits. Root owns formal protocol/release.
bounded_design_draft.interpretation_boundary: P1/u relative-error amplification alone does not establish high spatial frequency. Oracle-affine removal and geometry-length associations can weaken or motivate a representation hypothesis, but do not establish causality, describe full validation performance, or choose future architecture/loss from this sample.
not_yet_measured: No affine coefficients, bin thresholds, errors/cross terms, runtime or memory
No formal experiment or execution release
